semantic_contract.coefficients: Arbitrary commutative ring R for scalar products, matrix inverse and formal-series identities. Nontrivial R is added only for polynomial denominator nonvanishing. Field K is added only for RatFunc reduced denominator.
semantic_contract.scalar_walks: Old genuine unrestricted ExactWalk list subtype with source/target and positive integer weight; products retain every edge occurrence. Reuses proved actual-walk first-edge equivalences, never assumes coefficient recurrence.
semantic_contract.multigraded_walks: Actual unrestricted list subtype with full Finsupp vector sum fixed to n. Every edge vector is nonzero. Total degree gives a finite embedding into scalar ExactWalk and is used only for finiteness; coefficients retain full vectors.
semantic_contract.endpoint_weights: Arbitrary u,v:V→R contracted as sum_i sum_j u_i * coefficient_ij * v_j; equivalent to displayed u_i v_j product by ring commutativity.
semantic_contract.rationality: The independently defined semantic series matrix satisfies (I−A)S=1. Polynomial determinant Q has constant coefficient1, whose invOfUnit constructs the scalar inverse. Adjugate identities give two-sided inverse and identify S with rational matrix, then Q Z=P.
semantic_contract.recurrence: Generic Q Z=P gives convolution recurrence whenever P.coeff n=0; degree theorem uses Polynomial.degree : WithBot Nat. P=0 and n=0 are included. Scalar endpoint specialization also supplied.
semantic_contract.reduced_denominator: Over Field K, endpointRationalFunction is the explicit numerator/determinant RatFunc. Its reduced denominator divides Q; scalar_endpoint_unique ties Q Z=P to the independently defined series.
semantic_contract.empty_and_parallel: No nonempty vertex/edge assumption. List walks permit loops/repeated edges and parallel edges are separately indexed by E.
